description: This file defines the main application component for a tic-tac-toe game using React, including the game logic and UI.

methods.name: calculateWinner(squares)
methods.description: Calculates the winner of the tic-tac-toe game based on the current state of the squares.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main component that holds the state of the game and renders the UI.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles the player's click on the squares to update the game state.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the game (winner, draw, or next player).
